scope: Task 5 — frontend preview panel for keyboard steps (16-persistent-keyboard). Files: frontend/components/funnels/FunnelMessagePreview.vue, frontend/types/funnel.ts, frontend/i18n/locales/uk.json + en.json, frontend/tests/components/funnels/FunnelMessagePreview.spec.ts

verifiedInvariants.invariant: A03 stored-XSS guard: keyboard branch renders rendered text + raw labels as literal text only
verifiedInvariants.evidence: FunnelMessagePreview.vue:239 keyboardText via {{ }}; lines 254-258 each label via {{ label }} text interpolation. No v-html/innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/domPropsInnerHTML anywhere in the component (grep returned 0 real sinks; all 6 'v-html' string occurrences are in comments). The hostile-payload test (spec.ts:518-532) asserts / from a markup payload do NOT materialize in funnel-preview-keyboard-text or funnel-preview-keyboard, and the source-level guard (spec.ts:167-172) fails the build on any v-html=/innerHTML= use after comment stripping.

verifiedInvariants.invariant: Keyboard mock reads the clamped response keyboardRows (string[][]), not raw step input
verifiedInvariants.evidence: keyboardMockRows (vue:85-88) reads rendered.value.keyboardRows (PreviewStepResponse.keyboardRows: string[][]), gated on kind==='keyboard'. Labels are server-clamped (<=10x<=4, label <=64) per type doc (funnel.ts:257-258). Each label is still output as text, so even an unclamped/hostile label cannot become a DOM sink.

verifiedInvariants.invariant: A10 SSRF / no URL dereference from keyboard data
verifiedInvariants.evidence: The keyboard branch carries no mediaUrl/href/src — it is pure text (keyboardText + label chips). grep for fetch/$fetch/new Image/.src=/window.open/location in the component returned none beyond the store preview() call. Reply-keyboard labels are plain text by Telegram contract (KeyboardButton has only .text). The pre-existing media :src/:href paths (IMAGE/FILE/ALBUM) remain http(s)-scheme-guarded via isHttpUrl (vue:23-26, 287, 314, 352), rejecting file:/data:/javascript: and opaque file_id tokens; covered by spec.ts:196-208 and 263-274.

verifiedInvariants.invariant: No identity/PII leakage in the new/changed type fields
verifiedInvariants.evidence: PreviewStepResponse (funnel.ts:259-264) exposes exactly renderedBlocks, sampleData, kind, keyboardRows — no ownerChatId/chatId/userId/phone/email (matches Decision 8 'no ownerChatId/identity leakage'). The keyboard request fields (PreviewStepRequest keyboardText/keyboardParseMode/keyboardRows, funnel.ts:215-223) are author-authored funnel-definition data, not subscriber identity. Variable substitution producing sample data is flagged via sampleData and shown as a neutral indicator, not real subscriber PII.

vue:244 :aria-label binds a static i18n string t('funnels.editor.previewKeyboardAria'); Vue attribute binding auto-escapes and the value is not user-controlled. The two new i18n keys (uk.json/en.json) are static literals with no interpolation.

keyboardText returns null when renderedBlocks[0] is absent or not TEXT (vue:77-81); keyboardMockRows defaults to [] and filters non-array/empty rows (vue:85-88); template v-if guards (vue:236, 242) render nothing rather than crash. Covered by spec.ts:452-474.
